full_name: Amsale Alemu | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2020–2021 Edna Newman Shapiro, Class of 1936, and Robert Newman Shapiro, Class of 1972, Graduate Student Fellow Harvard University
bio: Amsale (Amy) Alemu is a PhD candidate in the Department of African and African American Studies at Harvard University. Her work engages Black transnationalism, Ethiopian political thought, and digital and multimedia scholarship.
